# Advanced Indian Pest Solution (AIPS)

> Advanced Indian Pest Solution (AIPS) is a licensed pest control company headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal, India, providing residential, commercial and industrial pest management across West Bengal. Founded in 2010, AIPS has served 40,000+ homes and businesses using CIB-approved, family-safe treatments delivered by in-house trained technicians.

## Contact
- Phone: +91 94774 01805

- Hours: Mon–Sat, 9 AM – 7 PM

## Services
- Cockroach control (odourless gel-baiting)
- Termite control (drill-and-inject anti-termite treatment, pre- and post-construction)
- Bed bug control (heat + residual spray protocol)
- Rodent control (trap-and-monitor, tamper-proof bait stations)
- Mosquito control (larvicidal treatment + residual mist)
- Ant control
- Lizard control (herbal repellent)
- Silverfish control
- Carpet beetle control
- Wood borer control
- Spider control
- Fly control
- Stored grain & seed pest control
- General pest control (combined residential package)
- Commercial pest control (HACCP/FSSAI-aligned, for restaurants, hotels, hospitals, offices, food processing)
- Herbal / botanical-only pest control (safe for newborns, asthmatics and pets)

## Areas served
West Bengal only: Kolkata (head office), Howrah, Hooghly, Durgapur, Asansol, Burdwan, Arambagh and Siliguri.

Kolkata localities covered include Jadavpur, Ballygunge, Tollygunge, Salt Lake (Bidhannagar), New Town, Behala, Garia, Dum Dum, Rajarhat, Alipore, Bhowanipore and Park Street.
